_about: Shield progression: the MORDHAU shield a Skyrim shield becomes, by words in the Skyrim shield's name; the first matching row wins, a row with empty name_contains is the fallback for its armour kind (light / heavy / any). MORDHAU's own numbers for each shield (read from the player's install) are in the notes: stamina taken off a blocked blow's cost, and whether it has the shield wall (held block). play-test note, 2026-10-09.

rows.note: the Nords' round shield: shield wall, stamina negation 10, parry window offset 0.10
small and quick, timed parry only (no shield wall), stamina negation 14
light, timed parry only (no shield wall), stamina negation 13
the all-rounder: shield wall, stamina negation 13
the largest: shield wall, stamina negation 12
